For security-sensitive reports use [private reporting](https://github.com/SeanShaffer88/win-pipe-revival/security/advisories/new).

## Version and environment
- Release/tag or full commit:
- Windows edition and build:
- CPU architecture and compiler/toolset:
- Native or managed API (if applicable):

## Minimal reproduction
Use a small synthetic example. Include build commands, expected result, actual result, and whether the failure repeats. For IPC problems include both peer versions, process architecture and connection/shutdown order.

## Redacted diagnostics
Paste only the relevant error text. Remove credentials, user names, private paths and payload data. Do not upload full memory dumps publicly.
